title: Gillibrand and Rubio's push for accountability over rogue programs

tellings.quote: first order the interest of the Gillibbrands and the Rubios etc. for the last several years has not really been disclosure, it's been accountability. Yeah. It's finding out that there's rogue programs that they had no idea it were in existence that were controlling groundbreaking world shaking information.

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2024, says that US senators such as Kirsten Gillibrand and Marco Rubio have spent the last several years chasing accountability more than disclosure. According to Pines, what drives them is learning that rogue secret programs they never knew existed were holding world-shaking information. If true, it would mean parts of the government kept such knowledge even from Congress.
